records.locator: Example 25, starting-material preparation: 4-hydroxybenzoic acid to the expressly named 4-hydroxybenzoyl chloride residue, before tetrahydropyridine addition.
records.source_conditions: 4-Hydroxybenzoic acid 11.04 g, thionyl chloride 80 mL and DMF 0.1 mL, reflux 2 h; evaporation and toluene coevaporation. Residue containing the named acid chloride was carried into the subsequent amidation.
records.experimental_product_status: Named crude acid-chloride intermediate carried forward; not individually isolated or characterized and no separate yield stated.
records.structural_reconciliation: Independently transcribed para-hydroxybenzoic acid and para-hydroxybenzoyl chloride. Phenolic OH remains unmodified; only carboxylic OH is replaced by Cl. Exact two-substrate reaction key equals 2107b4614f148f6d0eca63556b7e2c74f44178d46dc2480472e5ed8310a3fd23.
records.scope_limit: Performed net reaction precedent for the named crude intermediate only; no claim of isolated-product purity, physical elementary mechanism or whole-route experimental validation.

records.checked_passage: The residue was reacted further as the crude product.
records.locator: Intermediate 39, Step 1: 3,5-difluoro-benzoic acid chloride, before the distinct Step 2 Friedel-Crafts acylation.
records.source_conditions: 3,5-Difluorobenzoic acid (source reports 1.63 g, 10.00 mmol), thionyl chloride 20 mL, boiling 2 h; evaporate to dryness and coevaporate twice with toluene. Source reports 1.45 g, 82% of theoretical, as crude product used in Step 2.
records.experimental_product_status: Named crude acid chloride; source-reported mass/yield, not an analytically purified isolated yield. Acid mass/mmol retained as printed.
records.structural_reconciliation: Independent name transcription preserves the 3,5-difluoro ring pattern, replaces only carboxylic OH with Cl, and includes SOCl2 as the chlorinating substrate. Exact key equals 54798b9360c12d12eeaa1e133468943fe9699fdd868e65b9cf2049a175e38f9d.
records.scope_limit: Step 1 net reaction only. Step 2's 93% yield and product characterization are not assigned to this acid chloride or the model's internal arrows.

records.locator: Step 1.3, Preparation of 2-methylphenyl acetate; distinguish the later Step 1.4 Fries rearrangement.
records.source_conditions: o-Cresol 21.6 g/0.2 mol in aqueous NaOH (12 g/0.3 mol, water 100 mL), ice 300 g; acetic anhydride 30.6 g/0.3 mol, shake 1 min. Ether extraction and reduced-pressure distillation give 25 g, 83.3%; boiling point 66 C/1 mmHg.
records.experimental_product_status: Distilled 2-methylphenyl acetate with mass, yield and boiling point reported.
records.structural_reconciliation: Transcribed o-cresol and acetic anhydride independently from the preparation; acetylation is on phenolic O, retaining the ortho ring methyl. Exact key equals 6b268cc82298b3899f59c70e0cfb196555fe2fe6b261a14fd61766241e26e1f2.
records.scope_limit: This isolated net O-acetylation is supported, not the subsequent rearrangement or the actor's exact elementary arrow order.

records.scope_limit: The specific isolated C-N coupling transformation has primary precedent. This does not validate the model's auxiliary mixture, catalyst-free interpretation, symbolic arrows or whole route.
